title: Practice: Memory Layout and Representation

objective: Apply the ideas from Memory Layout and Representation in a small learning task.
target_skills: Value representation at a high level
acceptance_criteria: Apply the rule for value representation at a high level.
Include the required minimum evidence in the submitted answer.
